headline: Payload re-flagged Grumpy Walrus's ~229 ASCEND buys from 6:33-6:55 PM (already in the 7 PM run); it has made no moves since 6:55 PM. AIDA and SNEKG reached their 24h gates with no DEX pool, so not bonded, and stay in the SW-01 comparison group. EVRG had a sniper fully exit; CORE top cluster is up to ~81.4%. COCK side ~147.5k, 1.7% under its line. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: four Nov 1 evening swarm launches in a row (ANAKIN, MOGE, AIDA, SNEKG) failed to bond within 24h, so a swarm flag so far points to a launch that stalls on the curve rather than one that graduates.
